outcome: Composition of human milk fatty acids
Individual and total SFAs, MUFAs, and n-3 and n-6 PUFAs
cohort: 1094 mother-infant pairs from the CHILD Cohort (Canada)
finding: Human milk fatty acid profiles are highly variable and influenced by dietary, genetic, sociodemographic, health, and environmental factors.
mod_finding: No associations were observed between delivery mode and human milk fatty acid profiles.
